metadata.title: Artifact Signing Disabled in CI Pipeline — No Cryptographic Integrity Guarantee on Build Outputs

owasp: A08:2021 - Software and Data Integrity Failures

sources: Build artifacts produced by code-build task
transformations: sign-artifact step disabled — no cryptographic signing
sinks: Published artifacts lack provenance — tampered artifacts indistinguishable from legitimate ones

privilege_boundary.start_privilege: CI environment access or build artifact storage access
privilege_boundary.achieved_privilege: Malicious code in production builds — arbitrary code execution in all user browsers

impact.description: sign-artifact disabled in both CI stages. dind:true + IfNotPresent image policy amplify risk. No cryptographic provenance chain from source to deployment. Part of supply chain triad. CVSS 4.2 MEDIUM.

remediation.fix_approach: FIXED: sign-artifact re-enabled in code-checks and code-build. image_pull_policy: Always.

history.note: sign-artifact disabled in both code-checks and code-build blocks — dind: true in CI runner amplifies tamper risk
CONFIRMED MEDIUM: No artifact signing + dind:true + IfNotPresent = build tamper undetectable. Part of supply chain triad VULN-014+017+018. CVSS 4.2 MEDIUM.
FIXED: sign-artifact re-enabled in code-checks and code-build. image_pull_policy: Always.
